title: Minigame: A23.3 Placed DC

source.basis: Manufactured under R0.3 as the minigame of the A23.3 claim (the Rules-first plan, section 7): a squad Places a DC beside a building, its facts entered by hand.
source.legacy: None: a manufactured minigame (R0.3), adapting no legacy card
adaptation: A minimal card (ruling R22.3): who may Place a DC, and what its AFPh DR does, asked on the Rule Workbench.

introduction: A23.3's example: a squad Places its DC from Y6 into the building X5 and it detonates in the AFPh.

victoryConditions.text: A minigame has no victory: it proves its rules on the Rule Workbench and in play.
